book.totem.locksmith_manual.title: Locksmith Method Guide
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.1:
GETTING STARTED

Locksmith protects Chests, Trapped Chests, Barrels, double chests, and fixed-Hopper-connected storage. Start by crafting one Padlock.
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.2:
PADLOCK RECIPE

Five Iron Ingots and one Iron Nugget make one Padlock. The next page shows the live server recipe.
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.3:
APPLYING A LOCK

Hold the Padlock and use it on a Chest, Trapped Chest, or Barrel. The first container becomes the root. Loaded fixed Hoppers and supported containers in that network share the same lock.
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.4:
KEY BLANKS

Make Key Blanks before issuing physical keys. The iron recipe uses five Iron Nuggets; the copper alternative uses five Copper Ingots. Both make two blanks. The next page shows the live recipes.
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.5:
LOCK MANAGEMENT

Sneak and use an empty hand on a locked container or member Hopper. Owner and Manager players open Lock Management. Use the Keys tab, hold a Key Blank in either hand, then press Issue Key.
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.6:
USING KEYS

A valid Bound Key grants access only while it remains in the main hand or offhand. Revoke one key from the Keys tab, or let the Owner rotate every key. Blocked players stay denied even with a valid key.
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.7:
ACCESS & ROLES

Use Members to add online players and click their role to cycle it. Owner can assign Manager. In immersive worlds non-owner players still need a Bound Key; convenient worlds can grant direct Friends, Allowlist, or Public access.
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.8:
NETWORKS & AUTOMATION

Internal Hopper transfers inside one lock continue normally. Configure boundary automation from the Access tab. Breaking a middle Hopper leaves only the root component locked.
book.totem.locksmith_manual.page.9:
REMOVAL & RECYCLING

The Owner can press Remove Lock in Lock Management to return one Padlock. A Bound Key can be placed by itself in crafting to recycle it into one Key Blank. Commands remain only as an administrator fallback.
